title: hypolytrum longifolium subsp. nicaraguense
intro: Hypolytrum longifolium subsp. nicaraguense, commonly known as Nicaraguan hypolytrum, is a plant species belonging to the family Cyperaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Nicaraguan hypolytrum include analgesic and antipyretic effects, making it a potential treatment for pain and fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
